notes.text: Digest Task imports code from User Task (2 imports).
HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI), make REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask) and make REST calls to PUBLIC_API (FastAPI).
CHAT (FastAPI) reads PostgreSQL; INTERACTION (Flask) long-polls SQS, reads + writes PostgreSQL and makes API calls to LLM providers.

AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers, SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers and OUTREACH · WORKFLOWSCHEDULER workers long-poll SQS; AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers also read + write PostgreSQL; SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers also read + write PostgreSQL; OUTREACH · WORKFLOWSCHEDULER workers also read PostgreSQL; and also AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers enqueue follow-up SQS tasks; and also SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers enqueue follow-up SQS tasks.
